en.q: Which of the following is NOT an importance of the Himalayas as given in the unit?
options: It blocks the southwest monsoon winds and causes heavy rainfall in north India
It forms a natural barrier to the subcontinent
It protects India from cold winds blowing from central Asia
It is the source of rivers that dry up in summer
en.explanation: The Himalayas are the source of perennial rivers such as the Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra.

questions.quote: Characteristics of Himalayan Rivers: 1. Long and wide 2. Perennial in nature 3. Unsuitable for hydro power generation 4. Middle and lower courses are navigable

en.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of Himalayan rivers given in the unit?
options: Flow mostly westwards to the Arabian Sea
Middle and lower courses are navigable
en.explanation: Short, narrow and non-perennial rivers are Peninsular rivers; most Himalayan rivers flow eastwards or southwards to the Bay of Bengal, not westwards to the Arabian Sea. The middle and lower courses of Himalayan rivers are navigable.

ta.explanation: குறுகிய, வற்றும் தன்மையுடைய ஆறுகள் தீபகற்ப ஆறுகள்; பெரும்பாலான இமயமலை ஆறுகள் மேற்கு நோக்கி அரபிக்கடலில் அல்ல, கிழக்கு/தெற்கு நோக்கி வங்காள விரிகுடாவில் பாய்கின்றன. இமயமலை ஆறுகளின் நடு, கீழ்ப்போக்கு கப்பல் போக்குவரத்திற்கு ஏற்றது.

questions.quote: Characteristics of South Indian Rivers: 1. Originate from Western Ghats 2. Short and narrow 3. Non perennial in nature 4. Suitable for hydro power generation 5. Not useful for navigation

en.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of South Indian rivers?
en.explanation: Most South Indian rivers originate in the Western Ghats and are short, narrow and non-perennial.
